1.name: live taste-daemon (pre-approval)
1.description: Loop A surfaces every PROPOSED CHANGE to /admin/review BEFORE applying. Loop B surfaces every shipped page AFTER deploy preview. Roham clicks ✓/✗/🎨.

2.name: post-apply review
2.description: Orchestrator applies changes WITHOUT pre-approval if cross-vendor verdict = PASS. Roham reviews POST-apply. ✗ vote triggers REPAIR track.

3.name: post-apply with reduced cadence
3.description: Same as Phase 2 but cron cadence reduced to 1/4hr; cost gates tightened.

4.name: pure autonomous, infinite
4.description: Orchestrator applies without pre-approval; Roham reviews post-apply via /admin/review; cron tick every 30 min; loop cycles Tier A→B→C→D→Loop A DISCOVERY forever.

notes: P1+P3+P4+P5+P8+P10+P11 = load-bearing trio++. Must all be present in patches_shipped before Phase 4 is eligible. P2/P6/P7/P9/P12/P13 land incrementally and don't gate autonomy.
